prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a HIGH-DETAIL character proportion and material MASTER SHEET for a realistic fantasy game, not a sprite atlas. The provided image is the APPROVED Raphael identity. Preserve the same handsome adult male face and dark naturally curly hair, muted teal-gray embroidered short shoulder cape, fitted warm brown leather armor, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, one brushed steel shoulder, practical belts/pouches, brown trousers and leather calf boots. Preserve identity and believable clothing construction. Redraw anatomy properly; do not vertically stretch an image.
Create ONE landscape1536x1024 master image with FOUR complete full-body figures standing side by side in four generous columns. Same man, same adult body, same costume, SAME CAMERA SCALE in every column. Figures fully visible hair to boot soles, all tips inside image, no clipping; 40px clear margin at top/bottom and between silhouettes. One shared flat ground level near y950. NO text, labels, numbers, split lines, graphic overlays, scenery or UI. Background uniform light neutral warm-gray, shadow only a very faint contact under soles, neutral daylight5600K soft directional illumination, no gold/orange theatrical light or vignette.
PROPORTION IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: physically mature tall slender adult, about7.7 to8 HEADS TALL measured hair-top to chin as one head unit; head must be NATURALLY SMALL, not toy/doll/chibi. Skull, face and neck human proportions, broad enough shoulders but slim layered chest and a visibly defined waist, no barrel torso or bulky oversized belt pouches. Long elegant adult lower limbs: hip/leg-root to boot sole should read about53percent of full height as an ART DIRECTION TARGET. Place hip joints about46percent down from hair top; long thighs and shins with slender natural muscular anatomy, normal knee/ankle placement. Pants follow legs rather than inflating them; boots close-fitting, normal-sized feet. A clear narrow waist and high readable leg root, the torso must not consume half the body below the head. Do not make the legs short, thick or childlike. Do not increase head size for readability. Every figure should have same head-to-body ratio and same limb lengths.
FOUR POSES from LEFT to RIGHT: 1) RELAXED STANDING FRONT, erect neutral adult stance, knees nearly straight, arms natural. 2) RELAXED STANDING RIGHT PROFILE, neutral vertical posture to reveal exact chest thickness, waist, pelvis and long legs. 3) RUNNING INITIAL CONTACT in RIGHT PROFILE, natural low endurance run, supporting boot landing just under hips, support knee softly flexed only about10degrees, trailing foot modestly behind; hip height stays within about2percent of standing hip height, only a gentle6-8degree whole-body forward lean, not folding torso over waist. 4) RUNNING PASSING in RIGHT PROFILE, pelvis almost as high as standing, supporting leg under body close to extended with soft knee, recovering boot passes LOW near ankle/low shin, not knee raised high or heel kicked to buttocks. Arms softly bent close to ribs, slight shoulder/hip counter-rotation. Contact and passing poses must keep body tall; no squat-run, crouching, seated hips, exaggerated split, high knees or big bob. Head height between standing and run should remain nearly consistent. These are two natural running proportion studies, not four dramatic action poses.
MATERIAL QUALITY: convincing fine-grain brown leather with real stitching, seam tension, subtle edge wear and varied roughness; natural ivory woven linen fibres and believable folds; teal-gray cape with subtle wool weave and restrained embroidery; brushed steel shoulder and exposed straight blade with directional grinding sheen, crisp thin edges and small scratches, never mirror plastic. Skin has subtle pores and natural complexion, curly hair individual strands and varied locks; face is not waxy, airbrushed, doll-like or cartoon. Maintain natural subtle contrast, neutral white balance and consistent realistic fantasy illustration quality across all four figures, not glossy3D mobile-game plastic. Highly resolved details without turning every edge gold.
Keep sword/scabbard unobtrusive so legs and waist remain readable. Standing front may show a slender straight steel sword held with hand at low waist, blade almost vertical beside the leg and tip above ground; other figures keep sword sheathed by the belt so weapon does not force crouch or obscure the leg structure. No giant weapons, no new equipment, bow, staff, shields or magical effects. Preserve the approved adult identity, improve anatomy and credible materials. Main visual result must be a visibly SMALLER HEAD, THINNER TORSO, CLEAR WAIST, LONGER SLENDER LEGS and TALL HIP POSITION WHILE RUNNING, not simply a stretched old squat sprite.
